arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fraud_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS distinct_users FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions labelled as fraud and the distinct users who made them, going from transactions to cards to users.
assumptions: A fraud transaction is one with fraud_labels.is_fraud = 1; unlabelled transactions are excluded.
A user made a transaction when the transaction's card belongs to that user (cards.user_id).
